# JobFace

> Free browser-based photo cropping and a basic resume builder. Canonical website: https://jobface.wezzik.com/

## Current capabilities
- Center-crop an existing JPG, PNG or WebP into a 720 × 720 or 1080 × 1350 JPG. File limit: 20 MB; decoded image limit: 60 megapixels.
- Build one text-only, single-column HTML resume. PDF is available through the browser's print function, not a direct export.
- Process photo and resume inputs locally in the browser. No account or paid plan.

## Limits
No AI face generation, background replacement, retouching, cloud saving, direct PDF/DOCX export, ATS scoring or guaranteed hiring outcomes. Four illustrated layouts are examples, not four downloadable templates. Regional advice is scoped and sourced in the guides.
